Repair: before gap detection map each feed spelling to its instrument_master-canonical ticker when the literal spelling is absent from instrument_master and exactly one class or preferred variant spelling is present (ambiguous or absent stays literal, fail closed), group histories by the canonical ticker, record the feed spellings on the candidate row, and treat an existing literal decision key as known for its canonical form so nothing is re-emitted.
